library(terra)

climate_dir <- "~/SeasonalTrendsEdited/data/TerraClimate"

  precipitation = list(

    ),

      file.path(
        climate_dir,

  temperature = list(

      )
    ),

        "short_season_temperature_1997_2024.tif"

  ),

  solar_radiation = list(

      )
    ),

      file.path(

    )
  ),

      )
    ),
    short = rast(

  soil_moisture = list(
    long = rast(

      )
    ),
    short = rast(
      file.path(
        climate_dir,

      )
    )
  )
)


acf_fun <- function(x) {

  x_mean <- global(
    x,
    "mean",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )[, 1]

  x_acf <- acf(
    x_mean,
    lag.max = 3,
    plot = FALSE
  )$acf[2:4]

  n <- length(x_mean)

  acf_limit <- 1.96 / sqrt(n)

  data.frame(
    lag = 1:3,
    acf = as.numeric(x_acf),
    significant =
      abs(as.numeric(x_acf)) > acf_limit
  )
}


acf_results <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    names(climate_stacks),
    function(variable) {

      do.call(
        rbind,
        lapply(
          c("long", "short"),
          function(season) {

            result <- acf_fun(
              climate_stacks[[variable]][[season]]
            )

            result$variable <- variable
            result$season <- season

            result
          }
        )
      )
    }
  )
)

acf_results <- acf_results[
  ,
  c(
    "variable",
    "season",
    "lag",
    "acf",
    "significant"
  )
]

print(acf_results)

acf_limit <- 1.96 / sqrt(28)

print(acf_limit)

write.csv(
  acf_results,
  "~/SeasonalTrendsEdited/output/climate_ACF_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
